question: Δ ABC is an equilateral triangle. The side BC is produced to point D. If A joines D and BC = CD, then the degree measure of angle CAD is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

Δ ABC is an equilateral triangle.

BC = CD

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e8e7bfb9716c4137891bd3fb9b8f5fc7e4e4d8e673af25a2b55e1cbe3d3fad.png] 

According to the question,

∠ABC = ∠BCA = ∠BAC = 60°

So, ∠ACD = 180°- 60° = 120°

BC = CD --------------------------(1)

AC = BC --------------------------(2)

From eq. (1) & (2)

AC = CD

∠ADC = ∠CAD 

In Δ ACD,

∠ADC + ∠CAD + ∠ACD = 180°

⇒ ∠CAD + ∠CAD = 180° - 120°

⇒ 2∠CAD = 60° 

⇒ ∠CAD = 30°

**∴The degree measure of angle CAD is 30°.**
